veranderings.blok: Wat beeste vir die boere gegee het
veranderings.rede: 'hulle vleis' can be read as the farmers' own meat; 'die vleis' refers plainly to the cattle's meat.
Afrikaans speaks of a custom 'by' a people or community; 'van' reads woodenly here.
'nie seker weet nie' is colloquial; 'nie seker wees of ... nie' is the standard idiom and keeps the same meaning.
